info.title: finfy API
info.description: API of the finfy web app (route handlers in apps/web/app/api). Errors are stable codes in `error`; the client translates them (wiki/decisoes/0011). Authentication is a session cookie set by sign-in or e-mail verification.

tags.name: wallets
tags.description: Wallets and roles (wiki/decisoes/0002). Writes are idempotent by `mutationId` and audited

tags.name: accounts
tags.description: Accounts of a wallet; the balance is computed, never stored

tags.name: categories
tags.description: System categories (read-only, hideable per wallet) and the wallet's own; two levels

tags.name: transactions
tags.description: Income, expenses and transfers; amounts are positive minor units, the type gives the direction

tags.name: cards
tags.description: Credit cards, purchases (with installments) and invoices. A purchase goes to the invoice whose closing date is on or after its date; invoices are addressed by reference month `YYYY-MM`

tags.name: planning
tags.description: Monthly budget limits per top-level expense category, and goals with deposits

tags.name: members
tags.description: Who has access to a wallet. Without e-mail, an invite is a private link (token shown once, valid 7 days); accepting needs the link and the account with the invited e-mail

tags.name: activity
tags.description: The wallet's audit log (wiki/decisoes/0006): every member sees everything

tags.name: tags
tags.description: Tags of a wallet, unique by name ignoring case; entries reference them by ID

tags.name: recurrences
tags.description: Schedules that create pending entries (occurrences) up to 90 days ahead, with deterministic IDs so they never duplicate

tags.name: rules
tags.description: Categorization rules: AND conditions, actions set the category and add tags; never on transfers, payments or adjustments

tags.name: patrimony
tags.description: Assets and debts by ownership share, and the net worth

session.name: finfy_session
session.description: HttpOnly session cookie. Named `__Host-finfy_session` in production.

post.description: **While e-mail delivery is off (now):** creates the account, starts a session (cookie) and answers `app`; an e-mail that already has an account gets `409 emailTaken`. **Once it is on:** always answers `verifyEmail`, whether or not the e-mail has an account, and e-mails a code (or a notice). The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.

403.description: Wrong origin.

409.description: The e-mail already has an account (only while e-mail delivery is off).

429.description: Too many attempts. `Retry-After` header and `retryAfterSeconds` say when to try again.

The request must carry an `Origin` header equal to the app's origin; otherwise `403 forbiddenOrigin`.
